description:
A collection of all the messages in the chat. Nullable.

TIP: Lists messages in a Teams chat — the actual conversation content. Each message has id, createdDateTime, lastModifiedDateTime, deletedDateTime (if soft-deleted), from (sender identity), body (HTML or text content), attachments, mentions, reactions, importance, subject, replyToId. INVESTIGATION WORKFLOW: use $orderby=createdDateTime+desc&$top=50 to get the most recent messages, or $filter=createdDateTime ge YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ for time-window scoped queries. The body.content may be HTML — strip tags for plain text. Soft-deleted messages have deletedDateTime set but content is still retrievable (up to 21 days post-deletion per Microsoft Teams Export APIs). LEGAL CAVEAT: reads of chats without a formal eDiscovery case must be documented in the internal investigation journal to respect PIPEDA/Loi 25/GDPR (motif légitime). For court submission, prefer eDiscovery v3 export. BILLING: free since 2025-08-25 (previously metered via Teams Export API). Tip: pass `$top=250` (Microsoft's recommended max), use `$filter=lastModifiedDateTime` for incremental sync to avoid re-reading same messages. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $expand=replies, $orderby.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.
